crossRefs.note: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall…
You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which…
You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He wrote there on the stones a copy of Moses’ law, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
translations.bsb: And there in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua inscribed on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
translations.kjv: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
translations.asv: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote, in the presence of the children of Israel.
